thread:
aisha-peopleops: Heads up — closing the evidence collection window for SOC2/ISO next Friday at 18:00 PT. This is the last mile to get artifacts into the Evidence Vault (https://redwood.internal/evidence-vault). If you haven't uploaded, please prioritize this week. :running_shirt_with_sash:

A short checklist so you don't get blocked: access review exports, change-control logs (ticket exports or signed approvals), vendor agreements with PII redacted, network diagram PDFs, DR test reports, role-based access screenshots/config, and any dataflow diagrams for services handling customer data.

aisha-peopleops: Naming rule (copy verbatim):
```
soc2_v2025_<team>-<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf
# example: soc2_v2025_serving-change-control-20250402.pdf
```

aisha-peopleops: Upload notes: use "Team Upload" and set the evidence owner in the form on the upload page. Files >50MB: use the secure transfer link. If redaction is needed, reach out and we'll help scrub PII.

aisha-peopleops: Please do three things: 1) upload artifact, 2) add yourself as evidence owner, 3) reply with :white_check_mark: in this thread.

devon-eng: Do ticket exports need approver signatures? We usually have approvers listed in the ticket system.

aisha-peopleops: Ticket exports are fine as long as approver names and timestamps are present. If approvals are in email/docs, include a screenshot showing the approver and date.

nate-security: For network diagrams — are redacted CIDRs ok? We removed propagation-level CIDRs from customer-facing docs.

aisha-peopleops: Auditors want zone-level diagrams. CIDRs not required unless the doc is internal only. Always redact customer IPs.

emma-privacy: Privacy training evidence: CSV or LMS screenshot?

aisha-peopleops: CSV export preferred (it maps users to employee IDs). Screenshots accepted as fallback; label them `privacy-training` in the filename.

ComplianceBot: Automated reminder scheduled: 24 hours before the deadline we'll post a summary of teams still missing artifacts. If you get pinged, please chase your team.

devon-eng: I've uploaded the change-control export and set myself as owner. Marked with :white_check_mark:.

aisha-peopleops: Thanks Devon — noted. If anybody needs help with redaction or scanning, DM me and we can assist. Auditors begin sampling Monday AM; late uploads may trigger extension requests. Please try to finish by the deadline. :calendar:
